proposition: Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī identified Ibn Turka as his teacher in occultism, and the late Timurid period considered the two men the most prominent intellectuals of Shahrukhid Iran.

mediation.who: Bākharzī, Maqāmāt-i Jāmī; Dawlatshāh, Tazkirat al-Shuʿarā
mediation.note: reception a century or more later
